title: marked: add ==highlight== inline syntax across the whole pipeline
prompt: This is a copy of marked 4.3.0 (src/, ES modules). Add GFM-style highlight syntax: `==text==` becomes `<mark>text</mark>`, the same way `~~text~~` becomes `<del>`. Requirements: it is an inline token of type `mark` with `raw`, `text` and child `tokens` (so `==*x*==` nests emphasis); the opening marker must be followed, and the closing marker preceded, by a non-space (so `a == b == c` stays literal); it does not apply inside code spans or when the `gfm` option is false; there is a `mark(text)` method on Renderer (overridable like the others) and on TextRenderer so heading ids ignore the markers (`# a ==b== c` gets id `a-b-c`); and plain `=` in text such as `a=b` is unaffected. Follow how `del` is wired through rules, tokenizer, lexer, parser and the renderers.
